$description: Popover's tokens (plan 0006 §0s). The build generates styles/components/kinds/popover.css and popover.generated.ts from the popover group.

popover.$description: Styles the content panel. Each variant is a surface role read from the family in scope; the old presets map to: default → elevated; glass → glass + deep; stark → stark + glow; flat → flat + minimal; matte → neuro + solid. The kind owns its radius and border width (the class map's rounded-md and border).
